$comment: Spec 28 section 9.6 labelled-sample format. Ground truth, NOT a judgement of any one proposal: `referenceName` is what the module/function is really called, so the same sample grades any backend. Labels here are derived mechanically from the bundle's own sourcemap (tests/fixtures/bundles/expensify-app-0.86.0/index.android.bundle.map), which is shipped with the fixture and is authoritative for this app; `tests/gate/llm-readability/quality.test.ts` re-checks every `source` against that map, so a stale entry fails the gate rather than rotting. Register-level (kind "register") labels are generated by tools/readability/label-registers.ts: one hermesc -O -g run's -dump-ra and -dump-bytecode are joined to .hbc function ids by function order (verified per function), minified parameter names are resolved through the sourcemap at the parameter's own position; only app-source (not node_modules, not polyfill) modules are kept. Environment variables have no recorded declaration position and are not labelled. This committed sample is 300 randomly picked (LCG seed 12345) src functions out of 25998 with labelled parameters (full label run: 98,775 functions joined, 40,391 resolved parameter labels, 0 name mismatches); the full set is reproducible with label-registers.ts.
